title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is rooted in a deeply ingrained social culture that prioritizes blind obedience over constructive dialogue. From households to classrooms and professional workplaces, individuals are conditioned to view questioning authority as an act of disloyalty. This systemic pattern discourages critical thinking and reinforces hierarchical power structures, which ultimately hinders the country's progress toward a more democratic society.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዴሞክራሲ ተግዳሮቶች መነሻው ለስልጣን ባለው አመለካከት ላይ የተመሰረተ ጥልቅ ማህበራዊ ባህል ነው። ከቤተሰብ እስከ ትምህርት ቤት እና የስራ ቦታዎች ድረስ፣ ሰዎችን ለባለስልጣናት ወይም ለአለቆች ጥያቄ ማቅረብ እንደ አለመታዘዝ የሚቆጠርበት አሰራር ተስፋፍቷል። ይህ አሳታፊ ያልሆነና የሃይል ተዋረድን ብቻ የሚያጠናክር አስተሳሰብ ለዴሞክራሲያዊ ስርአት ግንባታ ትልቅ እንቅፋት ሆኗል።
oromo: Rakkoon dimokiraasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu, aadaa hawaasaa aangoo fi aboo fudhachuu wajjin wal qabatee jiru irraa maddatti. Maatii irraa eegalee hanga mana barumsaafi bakka hojiitti, namoonni aangoo irratti gaaffii kaasuu akka gantummaatti akka ilaalan ta'aniiru. Adeemsi kun yaada bilisaa fi marii dhorkuun, caasumaa aangoo cimaa irratti waan hundaa'uuf, biyyattiin gara sirna dimokiraasii dhugaatti akka hin ceene gufuu ta'eera.

title: India win second T20 in Zimbabwe to take series as Kishan and Varma shine
english: India secured a T20 series victory over Zimbabwe by winning the second match in Harare by 90 runs. Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma led the scoring, helping India set a challenging target of 219. Zimbabwe struggled to chase the total and were bowled out for 129, giving India an unbeatable 2-0 lead in the three-game series.
amharic: ሕንድ በሀራሬ በተካሄደው ሁለተኛው የቲ-20 የክሪኬት ጨዋታ ዚምባብዌን በ90 ሩጫ በማሸነፍ ተከታታይ ድል አስመዝግባለች። ኢሻን ኪሻን እና ቲላክ ቫርማ ባሳዩት ድንቅ ብቃት ህንድ 219 ሩጫዎችን ማስመዝገብ ችላለች። የዚምባብዌ ቡድን ግቡን ለማሳካት ተቸግሮ በ129 ሩጫ በመውጣቱ ህንድ የሶስት ጨዋታዎች ተከታታይ ድሉን 2 ለ 0 በሆነ ውጤት አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Indiyaa tapha kiriketi T20 lammaffaa Haraaree keessatti gaggeeffame irratti Ziimbaabuwee 90n mo'achuun injifannoo walitti aansuudhaan fudhatteetti. Ishaan Kiishaan fi Tiilaak Vaarmaa qabxii gaarii galchuudhaan Indiyaan 219 akka galchitu gargaaraniiru. Ziimbaabuween qabxii kana galchuuf yaaltus, 129 qofa galchuun taphichi erga xumuramee booda Indiyaan 2-0n leencuu dandeesseetti.

title: ‘We have done it’: Joy as ‘Cockroach’ protests push India minister out
english: India's Education Minister, Dharmendra Pradhan, has resigned following 36 days of intense youth-led protests triggered by widespread exam paper leaks. The movement was spearheaded by the 'Cockroach Janta Party,' a satirical group formed after officials disparaged young protesters. With their primary demands met, including government accountability and support for affected families, the demonstrators have successfully concluded their campaign.
amharic: የህንድ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር ድሃርሜንድራ ፕራድሃን በፈተና ወረቀት መፍሰስ ቅሌት ሳቢያ በተነሱ የ36 ቀናት የተማሪዎች ተቃውሞ ምክንያት ከስልጣናቸው ለቀቁ። ተቃውሞውን የመሩት ወጣቶች በባለስልጣናት 'ጠረንቋና ጥገኛ' ተብለው መጠራታቸውን ተከትሎ 'ኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ' የተሰኘ አስቂኝ እንቅስቃሴ በመፍጠር ነበር። መንግስት የካሳ ክፍያ እና ይቅርታን ጨምሮ ሁሉንም የጠያቂዎቹን ጥያቄዎች በመቀበሉ ተቃዋሚዎቹ እንቅስቃሴያቸውን በድል አጠናቀዋል።
oromo: Ministirri barnoota Indiyaa Dharmendra Pradhan, qormaata biyyaalessaa ilaalchisee rakkoo mudateen walqabatee guyyoota 36f hiriira cimaa dargaggootaa booda aangoo gadhiiseera. Dargaggoonni kun 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhu hundeessee, aanga'oonni akka 'ilbiisaatti' waan isaan salphisanif mormii isaanitti fayyadamuun sagalee isaanii dhageessisaniiru. Mootummaan fedhii hiriirtootaa guutuun gumaa maatiif kennuufi dhiifama gaafachuu hordofee, hiriirtoonni injifannoon guyyaa har'aa mormii isaanii xumuraniiru.

title: Syrian FM calls for Israeli withdrawal in meeting with UN chief
english: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani met with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres in Damascus to formally demand that Israel pull its forces out of southern Syria without conditions. During the visit, the UN chief also held discussions with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa. The meeting highlights ongoing diplomatic efforts regarding the status of the southern Syrian region.
amharic: የሶሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አሳድ አል-ሻይባኒ በደማስቆ ከተማ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ፀሐፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝን አግኝተዋል። በውይይቱ ወቅት እስራኤል ያለምንም ቅድመ ሁኔታ ከደቡብ ሶሪያ ወታደሮቿን እንድታስወጣ ጠይቀዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ዋና ፀሐፊ በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት ከሶሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ጋርም ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Sooriyaa Asaad al-Shaibani magaalaa Damaasqoo keessatti Qondaala olaanaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii Antooniyoo Guterres waliin wal arguun isaanii gabaafameera. Ministirichi mootummaan Israa'el loltoota ishee naannoo kibba Sooriyaa irraa haala tokko malee akka baastu gaafataniiru. Daawwannaa isaanii kanaan, Guterres pirezidaantii Sooriyaa Ahimad al-Sharaa waliinis mari'ataniiru.

title: The Battle Over Al-Aqsa
english: A large group of Israelis recently entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound accompanied by security forces. The visit was led by National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, sparking significant tension. This event has drawn widespread attention due to the sensitive nature of the site and its importance to the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: በርካታ እስራኤላውያን በጸጥታ ኃይሎች ታጅበው ወደ አል-አቅሳ መስጊድ ግቢ መግባታቸው አነጋጋሪ ሆኗል። ጉብኝቱን የመሩት የእስራኤል ብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር ናቸው። ይህ ድርጊት በስፍራው ያለውን ስሜታዊ ሁኔታ በመቀስቀስ ውጥረትን አባብሷል።
oromo: Humni Israa'eelotaa hedduun poolisootaan eegamaa gara dirree Masjiida Al-Aqsa seenanii jiru. Daawwannaa kana kan hogganan ministirri nageenya biyyoolessaa Israa'eel Itaamaar Ben-Gviiri dha. Gochi kun bakki kun iddoo rakkoo siyaasaa keessa jiru ta'uun isaa fi haala walxaxaa jiruun walqabatee mormii guddaa kaasee jira.

title: The Global South is being forced to choose creditors over children
english: Many developing nations are currently spending far more on repaying external debts than on providing education for their citizens. This global financial structure forces governments to prioritize payments to international creditors over essential funding for schools and students. As a result, millions of children face declining school quality and limited access to education while wealth flows out of poor nations toward wealthy financial institutions.
amharic: በርካታ ታዳጊ ሀገራት ለውጭ ዕዳ ክፍያ ከሚውለው ገንዘብ ይልቅ ለዜጎቻቸው ትምህርት የሚያውሉት በጣም አነስተኛ ነው። አሁን ያለው ዓለም አቀፍ የፋይናንስ ሥርዓት መንግስታት ለትምህርት ቤት ግንባታ እና ለተማሪዎች አገልግሎት ከሚሰጡት በጀት ይልቅ ለዓለም አቀፍ አበዳሪዎች ክፍያ ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ ያስገድዳቸዋል። በውጤቱም፣ ከፍተኛ የሀብት ፍሰት ከድሃ ሀገራት ወደ ሀብታም የፋይናንስ ተቋማት ስለሚሄድ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናት ጥራት ያለው ትምህርት የማግኘት እድላቸው እየተመናመነ ነው።
oromo: Biyoonni guddachaa jiran baay'een isaanii kaffaltii liqii alaa irratti baasii hedduu waan godhaniif, barnoota lammiilee isaaniif gahaa ta'e dhiyeessuu hin dandeenye. Sirni faayinaansii addunyaa ammaa kun mootummoonni maallaqa mana barumsaa fi barattootaaf oolu qaban duraan dursee liqii kaffaluuf akka oolchan dirqisiisa. Kunis sababa ta'ee biyyoota hiyyeeyyiirraa gara dhaabbilee faayinaansii sooressotaatti qabeenyi waan yaa'uuf, ijoolleen miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman barnoota gaarii argachuu dhabanii jiru.

title: Atletico Madrid sign South Korea World Cup star Lee Kang-In from PSG
english: South Korean midfielder Lee Kang-In has officially transferred from Paris Saint-Germain to Atletico Madrid on a contract lasting until 2031. The 25-year-old playmaker joins the Spanish team for an estimated fee of 35 to 40 million euros. He is expected to play a key creative role for the club following the departure of Antoine Griezmann.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያው አማካይ ሊ ካንግ-ኢን ከፓሪስ ሴንት ዠርሜን ወደ አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ እስከ 2031 ዓ.ም የሚቆይ ውል ተፈራርሟል። የ25 ዓመቱ ተጫዋች ወደ ስፔኑ ክለብ የተቀላቀለው ከ35 እስከ 40 ሚሊዮን ዩሮ በሚገመት የዝውውር ሂሳብ ነው። አትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ የአንቷን ግሪዝማንን መውጣት ተከትሎ የተፈጠረውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት በሊ ካንግ-ኢን የፈጠራ ችሎታ ላይ ትልቅ እምነት ጥሏል።
oromo: Giddu-galeessaan Kooriyaa Kibbaa Lee Kang-In Paris Saint-Germain gadhiisee gara Atletico Madrid kan ce'e yommuu ta'u, hanga bara 2031tti kan turu waliigaltee mallatteesseera. Taphataan umriin isaa 25 ta'e kun gara kilabii Ispeen kanatti kan makame qarshii Yuuroo miiliyoona 35 hanga 40 ta'uun akka ta'e gabaafameera. Atletico Madrid taphataa kana kan itti fayyadame, Antoine Griezmann erga kilabii kana gadhiisee booda bakka isaa buusuufi qindoomina taphaatiif gargaarsa akka ta'uufi.

title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 14
english: The fourteenth day of the conflict between the United States and Iran has arrived, marked by the first pause in American airstrikes following nearly two weeks of continuous bombing. Despite this brief halt in military activity, the situation in the Strait of Hormuz continues to be volatile. It remains unclear if diplomatic discussions are making any progress toward resolving the ongoing tension.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ግጭት በ14ኛው ቀኑ ላይ ይገኛል፤ ይህም ያለፉትን 13 ቀናት ያለማቋረጥ ሲካሄድ የነበረው የአሜሪካ የአየር ድብደባ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ መቆሙን ያሳያል። ምንም እንኳን ወታደራዊ ጥቃቱ ለአፍታ ቢገታም፣ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ከፍተኛ ነው። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለው የዲፕሎማሲ ውይይት ምን ደረጃ ላይ እንደሚገኝ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru guyyaa 14ffaa isaa irra ga’eera; kunis duula qilleensa irraa torban lama guutuu itti fufiinsaan gaggeeffamaa ture booda guyyaa jalqabaa dhaabate dha. Sochii waraanaa kana keessatti tasgabbii yoo jiraateyyuu, naannoo Hormuzitti waraansa cimaatu jira. Mariin dippilomaasii furmaata argamsiisuuf taasifamaa jiru maali irra akka ga’e ifatti hin beekamu.

title: F1 needs better balance between business and sport, says Norris
english: McLaren driver Lando Norris has criticized Formula One for prioritizing financial gain and business growth over the quality of the sport. He argues that recent technical regulation changes were driven by the desire to attract new manufacturers rather than to enhance racing performance. Norris also expressed concern that modern fans are increasingly focused on individual drivers rather than the sport itself, suggesting that the organizers need to refocus on the racing experience.
amharic: የማክላረን ተሽከርካሪ አሽከርካሪ ላንዶ ኖሪስ ፎርሙላ ዋን በስፖርታዊ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ከማተኮር ይልቅ ለገንዘብ እና ለንግድ ትርፍ ቅድሚያ እየሰጠ መሆኑን ተችቷል። በቅርቡ የተደረጉት የቴክኒክ ህግ ለውጦች የተከናወኑት የስፖርቱን ጥራት ለማሻሻል ሳይሆን አዳዲስ ኩባንያዎችን ለመሳብ በማሰብ መሆኑን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም አዲሶቹ ደጋፊዎች ለስፖርቱ አጠቃላይ ሂደት ከመጨነቅ ይልቅ በአሽከርካሪዎች ስብዕና ላይ ብቻ ማተኮራቸው ስፖርቱን እየጎዳው መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Abbaan konkolaataa McLaren Lando Norris, Formula One ispoorticha irratti xiyyeeffachuu mannaa bu'aa qabeessummaa fi daldalaaf dursaa kennuun isaa sirrii miti jechuun ceephera. Jijjiiramootni seeraa yeroo dhihoo as godhaman kanneen, qulqullina qophiichaa fooyyessuuf osoo hin taane, warshaalee haaraa harkisuuf jedhamee kan murtaa'an ta'uu ibseera. Akkasumas, hordoftootni ammaa ispoorticha waliigala isaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu mannaa, namoota dhuunfaa qofa hordofuun isaanii akka ispoortichi miidhamu godheera jechuun yaada isaa ibseera.

title: What’s behind the ICC investigation into Karim Khan?
english: The International Criminal Court's chief prosecutor, Karim Khan, has been removed from his position following allegations of sexual misconduct. His legal team claims these accusations are politically motivated and intended to discredit him for pursuing war crimes charges against Israeli officials. The investigation into his conduct has raised significant questions regarding the pressures facing the court's leadership.
amharic: የዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት ዋና አቃቤ ህግ ካሪም ካን በፆታዊ ትንኮሳ ክስ ከስልጣናቸው ተነስተዋል። የሕግ አማካሪዎቻቸው እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ክሶች በእስራኤል መሪዎች ላይ የጦር ወንጀል ክስ በመመስረታቸው የተነሳ የተፈጠረ የፖለቲካ ሴራ ነው። የካሪም ካን ከስልጣን መነሳት በዓለም አቀፉ ፍርድ ቤት አመራር ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጫና ጥያቄ ውስጥ አስገብቷል።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa olaanaa mana maree yakka addunyaa (ICC) Karim Khan, himata gudeeddii fi miidhaa walqunnamtii saalaa dhiyaateef hordofee hojii isaa irraa kaafameera. Gareen abukaattoota isaa akka jedhanitti, himannaan kun kan dhiyaateef hogganoota Israa'el irratti himata yakka waraanaa dhiyeessuu isaatiin walqabatee haaloo bahuuf kan qindaa'e dha. Buqqa'uun Karim Khan dhiibbaa mana murtichaa irra jiru irratti gaaffii guddaa uumee jira.

title: Iran blames US for Hormuz dispute as both sides confirm ongoing talks
english: Iran has accused the United States of violating their peace agreement by attempting to establish new transit routes through the Strait of Hormuz without consultation. Despite this tension, both countries have halted direct military strikes for the first time in two weeks, signaling a potential move toward de-escalation. While diplomatic channels are open and discussions are ongoing, significant mistrust remains, leaving the status of their interim deal uncertain.
amharic: ኢራን አሜሪካ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል ያለ ምክክር አዲስ የመተላለፊያ መስመሮችን ለመክፈት በመሞከር የሰላም ስምምነታቸውን ጥሳለች ስትል ከሳለች። ይህ ውዝግብ ቢኖርም፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ለሁለት ሳምንታት ሲካሄድ የነበረው ጥቃት መቆሙ የውጥረት መቀነስ ምልክት ታይቷል። ምንም እንኳን የሁለቱ ወገኖች የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ተጀምሮ ንግግሮች እየተካሄዱ ቢሆንም፣ ከፍተኛ አለመተማመን ስላለ ስምምነቱ አሁንም እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Iraan, Amerikaan karaa Hormuz keessatti marii tokko malee daandii haaraa banuuf yaaluun walii galtee nagaa isaanii akka cabsite himatteetti. Wal-dhabdeen kun jiraatus, biyyoonni lameen torban lamaaf wal-itti fufiinsaan raawwatamaa ture dhaabuun isaanii rakkoon sun akka hir'achaa jiru mul'isa. Karaan diippiloomaasii banamee mariin kan itti fufe ta'us, amanamummaan waan jiruuf walii galtichi yerootiif qofa ta'uu isaa dubbatameera.

title: Baby rescued after Israeli settlers set home on fire amid raids
english: A baby was saved by family members after Israeli settlers intentionally ignited a fire at their home in the occupied West Bank. This attack occurred during a wave of intensified raids by settlers and military forces in the Nablus area. These incidents follow a fatal shooting that took place on Friday, leading to heightened tensions in the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ እስራኤላውያን ሰፋሪዎች በአንድ ቤት ላይ ሆን ብለው እሳት በመልቀቃቸው ህፃን ልጅ በቤተሰቦቿ ታድጋለች። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በናብሉስ አካባቢ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች እየተካሄደ ባለው ተከታታይ ወረራ ወቅት ነው። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው ከአርብ ዕለት ገዳይ የተኩስ ልውውጥ በኋላ በተፈጠረው ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo waldhabiinsaan guutame kan West Bank keessatti, manni jireenyaa tokko qonnaan bultoota Israa'elii qabsiifamuu isaatiin, daa'imni tokko maatii isheetiin oolchamee jira. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo waraannii Israa'elii fi qonnaan bultoonni magaalaa Naablus keessatti duula bal'aa gaggeessaa jiranitti. Gochi kunis, gaafa Jimaataa dhukaasa du'aan xumurame booda sababa walitti bu'iinsa dabaluu isaatiin kan dhalate dha.

title: Iraqi air defences down drone near US consulate in Erbil
english: Iraqi military forces successfully intercepted and destroyed an unmanned aerial vehicle flying close to the American consulate in Erbil. Security officials confirmed that the incident took place on Saturday within the Kurdistan region. No further details regarding the drone's origin or potential motives were provided at this time.
amharic: የኢራቅ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በኢርቢል ከተማ ከሚገኘው የአሜሪካ ቆንስላ አቅራቢያ የሚበር ድሮን ተኩሰው መትተው ጥለዋል። የፀጥታ ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ክስተቱ የተፈጠረው ቅዳሜ ዕለት በኩርዲስታን ክልል ነው። ስለ ድሮኑ መነሻ ወይም ዓላማ የተገለጸ ተጨማሪ መረጃ የለም።
oromo: Humnootiin nageenyaa Iraaq magaalaa Erbiil keessatti konsulaata Ameerikaa biratti xiyyara nama hin feene (drone) tokko rukutanii kuffisaniiru. Maddoonni nageenyaa akka ibsanitti, gochi kun kan raawwatame Dilbata darbe naannoo Kurdiistaan keessatti dha. Hanga ammaatti waa'ee xiyyarichaa fi kaayyoo isaa irratti odeeffannoon dabalataa hin kennamne.

title: After ‘testing ground’ in Kashmir, pellet guns used on student protesters in India's capital
english: Indian security forces are facing allegations of using dangerous pellet guns against student protesters and journalists in New Delhi. While police initially denied these claims, the Rapid Action Force later acknowledged that excessive force had been used during the demonstrations for educational reform. These protests, which led to the resignation of the education minister, began after officials insulted unemployed youth and corruption scandals surfaced regarding medical entrance exams.
amharic: የህንድ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በኒው ዴልሂ በተማሪዎች እና በጋዜጠኞች ላይ አደገኛ የሆኑ የብረት ጥይቶችን (pellet guns) ተጠቅመዋል የሚል ክስ ቀርቦባቸዋል። ፖሊስ መጀመሪያ ላይ ይህን ቢክድም፣ የፈጣን ምላሽ ሰጪ ኃይል (RAF) በስልጠና እና በትምህርት ማሻሻያ ጥያቄዎች ላይ ተቃውሞ ሲያደርጉ የነበሩ ሰዎችን በመበተን ረገድ ከመጠን ያለፈ ኃይል መጠቀሙን አምኗል። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች የተጀመሩት በመንግስት ባለስልጣናት ንቀት እና የትምህርት ፈተና ሙስና ቅሌት ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ በመጨረሻም የትምህርት ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣናቸውን እንዲለቁ አስገድዷል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Hindii, Niiw Deelhiitti barattootaa fi gaazexeessitoota irratti miilaa (pellet guns) fayyadaman jedhamanii himatamaa jiru. Poolisiin jalqaba himannaa kana haaluus, humnoonni ittisaa (RAF) sochii barattootaa irratti humna garmalee fayyadamuu isaanii erga qorannoo booda hubataniiru. Tariiwwan kun kan jalqaban jechoota qeeqaa fi malaammaltummaa qormaata barnootaa irratti mufachuudhaan yoo ta'u, dhumarratti ministirri barnootaa aangoo gadi akka lakkisan taasisaniiru.

title: Iran's IRGC says four vessels stopped in Hormuz in last 24 hours
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps recently obstructed four ships in the Strait of Hormuz by firing warning shots. Officials stated the vessels were blocked for attempting to use a path labeled as an unsafe route. The military group has cautioned that any future ships found in restricted areas will encounter a firm and aggressive reaction.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይሎች በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር አራት መርከቦችን አስጠንቅቀው ማቆማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። መርከቦቹ የገቡት አደገኛ ተብሎ በተፈረጀ መስመር በመሆኑ የባህር ኃይሉ የማስጠንቀቂያ ተኩስ ከፍቷል። ድርጅቱ ወደፊትም በዚህ በተከለከለ መንገድ የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Waraana Iran (IRGC) dooniiwwan afur daandii galaana Hormuz irraa dhorkamuusaanii beeksisaniiru. Dooniiwwan kunneen karaa nageenya hin qabne jedhamee ramadame keessa waan darbuuf yaalaniif, humnoonni kun dhukaasa akeekkachiisaa bananiiru. Gareen kun gara fuulduraatti dooniiwwan daandii dhoorkame kana keessa darbuuf yaalan kamiyyuu irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Israel kills head of northern Gaza police force
english: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza City has resulted in the death of Brigadier-General Abdel-Nasser al-Maqadma, who served as the northern Gaza police chief. Additional reports indicate that other personnel, including a medic and a previously wounded officer, have also died in recent violence. Israel has frequently targeted members of the Gaza police force, asserting that these individuals are affiliated with Hamas.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የሰሜን ጋዛ የፖሊስ አዛዥ የሆኑት ብርጋዴር ጄኔራል አብደል-ናስር አል-መቃድማ መገደላቸው ተሰምቷል። በተጨማሪም በሌሎች ጥቃቶች አንድ የህክምና ባለሙያ እና ቀደም ብሎ ጉዳት ደርሶበት የነበረ አንድ የፖሊስ አባል ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እስራኤል የጋዛ ፖሊስ አባላት ከሀማስ ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው በሚል በተደጋጋሚ ኢላማ እያደረገች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Humni qilleensa Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa raawwateen ajajaan poolisii kaaba Gaaza, Biriigader Jeneraal Abdeel-Naasir al-Maqadmaan ajjeefamaniiru. Kana malees, haleellaa biraatiin gargaaraan fayyaa tokkoo fi poolisiin duraan miidhamee ture tokko lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Israa'el miseensonni poolisii Gaaza miseensa Haamaas akka ta'an ibsuun, yeroo baay'ee qaamoolee kana irratti haleellaa raawwatti.

title: Houthis claim attack on Saudi oil sites
english: Houthi fighters launched drone and missile strikes against two Saudi Aramco oil facilities in Jizan and Yanbu to retaliate against Saudi-led air raids in Yemen. The group also threatened to continue obstructing shipping in the Bab el-Mandeb strait, which has become a key route for Saudi oil exports. Meanwhile, subsequent Saudi air strikes in Yemen's Marib and al-Jawf regions reportedly killed several Houthi fighters and technical experts.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን ላይ ለሚፈጸሙ የአየር ጥቃቶች አጸፋ ለመስጠት በሳውዲ አረቢያ የጂዛን እና የያንቡ የአራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋማት ላይ በድሮን እና በባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። ቡድኑ የሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመር የሆነውን የባብ ኤል-ማንደብ ባህረ ሰላጤ መዝጋቱን እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። በምላሹም የሳውዲ ጥምረት በየመን በወሰደው የአየር ጥቃት በርካታ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች እና የቴክኒክ ባለሙያዎች መገደላቸው ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni Hutiin haleellaa qilleensa irraa irratti gaggeeffamuuf deebii kennuuf jecha, buufataaleen boba'aa Aramco kan Saudi Arabaa jiran lama, kanneen Jizan fi Yanbu jedhaman irratti haleellaa xiyyaara malee (drone) fi misayiliin raawwateera. Gareen kun daandii galaana Bab el-Mandeb kan Saudi-in boba'aa ittiin ergitu cufuusaa akka itti fufu akeekkachiiseera. Gamtaan Saudi ammoo buufataalee Hutiin to'atu irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa gaggeesseen miseensota Hutiifi ogeeyyota teeknikaa hedduu ajjeeseera.

title: Two buses collide in Syria, killing at least 35 people
english: A serious traffic accident occurred in central Syria when two passenger buses collided on the highway connecting Damascus and Deir ez-Zor. This tragic event resulted in at least 35 fatalities and left numerous others injured. Emergency responders have deployed helicopters to transport the survivors to a nearby military hospital for urgent medical care.
amharic: በሶሪያ መካከለኛው ክፍል በደማስቆ እና በዴር ኤዞር አውራ ጎዳና ላይ ሁለት አውቶቡሶች ተጋጭተው ከባድ አደጋ ደረሰ። በዚህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት ቢያንስ 35 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች በአቅራቢያ ወደሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ሆስፒታል ለማጓጓዝ ሄሊኮፕተሮችን አሰማርተዋል።
oromo: Siriyaa giddu galeessatti konkonkalaa imaltootaa lama karaa gurguddaa Daamaasqoo fi Deeyr Ez-Zoor wal quunnisiisu irratti walitti bu'aniin balaan ulfaataan mudateera. Balaa gaddisiisaa kanaan lubbuun namoota 35 ol darbeera, namoonni hedduunis miidhaniiru. Gargaarsa ariifachiisaa kennuufis xiyyaarota helikopterii fayyadamuun miidhamtoota gara hospitaala waraanaatti geeffachaa jiru.

title: India’s youth protesters are fighting Modi with irreverent humour and memes
english: Young protesters in India are using humor, memes, and viral social media content to challenge Prime Minister Narendra Modi's administration. By creatively mocking police actions and pro-government media, they are effectively shifting the public narrative and gaining wider support for their demands for educational reforms. This digital strategy has turned tense confrontations into relatable online content, helping activists cope while keeping pressure on a government sensitive to its public image.
amharic: በህንድ የሚገኙ ወጣት ተቃዋሚዎች የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲን አስተዳደር ለመቃወም ቀልዶችን፣ ሜሞችን እና የተለያዩ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ይዘቶችን እየተጠቀሙ ነው። ከፖሊስ ጋር የሚያደርጉትን ግጭት እና የመንግስት ደጋፊ ሚዲያዎችን በመቀለድ ህዝባዊ ትረካውን ወደራሳቸው በመቀየር የትምህርት ማሻሻያ ጥያቄያቸውን በስፋት እንዲስተጋባ እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ዲጂታል ስልት ተቃዋሚዎቹ ለራሳቸው መጽናኛ ከመሆናቸውም በላይ በመንግስት ላይ ያለውን ጫና እንዲጨምር አድርጓል።
oromo: dargaggoonni Hindii mootummaa muummicha ministeeraa Narendra Moodii mormuuf jecha kolfiisaa, meemii fi qabiyyee miidiyaalee hawaasummaa fayyadamaa jiru. Gamtaan kun walitti bu’iinsa poolisii fi gabaasa miidiyaa mootummaa deggaran irratti qoosuun yaada uummataa jijjiiruufi gaaffii jijjiirama barnootaa isaanii bal’inaan dhageessisuuf gargaareera. Dhiibbaan dijitaalaa kun mormitoonni akkaataa itti dhiphina keessatti of tasgabbessan ta’uun, mootummaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera.

title: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
english: President Trump attended the White House Correspondents' Dinner, an event held to celebrate press freedom following a shooting incident earlier this year. While he praised the resilience of the press and honored a Secret Service officer, he also used his speech to criticize journalists and political opponents. Despite the mixed tone of his remarks, the president emphasized the importance of settling disagreements through open debate rather than violence.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በተፈጠረ የተኩስ አደጋ ምክንያት ከተቋረጠ በኋላ ነፃነትን ለማክበር በተዘጋጀው የጋዜጠኞች ማህበር እራት ላይ ተገኝተዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ የጋዜጠኞችን ጥረት ቢያደንቁም በንግግራቸው ወቅት መገናኛ ብዙኃንን እና የፖለቲካ ተቀናቃኞቻቸውን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተችተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ንግግራቸው ቅይጥ ስሜት ቢኖረውም፣ አለመግባባቶችን በጠመንጃ ሳይሆን በውይይት መፍታት እንደሚገባ አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Tiraamp sirna soorata galgalaa kan gamtaa gaazixeessitoota Waayit Hawusirratti argamuun bilisummaa miidiyaa kabajuu ibsaniiru. Gochaan kun kan qophaa'e erga kanaan dura miidhaan dhukaasaa mudatee booda dha. Pirezidaantiin kun gaazixeessitoota kan galateeffatan ta'us, haasaa isaanii keessatti miidiyaaleefi mormitoota siyaasaa isaanii qeeqaniiru. Haasaa isaanii keessatti, wal-dhabiinsa kamiyyuu dhukaasaan osoo hin taane mariin furuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru.

title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
english: The Houthi group, which receives support from Iran, has launched a missile attack against Saudi Arabia following recent Saudi airstrikes on Yemen. This retaliation caused fires in the Saudi city of Jizan, leading to emergency alerts in the region. Meanwhile, broader tensions remain high as the U.S. continues its naval blockade and ongoing military posturing in the Middle East.
amharic: ኢራን የምትደግፋቸው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ የቦምብ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን በሚገኙ የሁቲ ይዞታዎች ላይ የአየር ድብደባ ካደረሰች በኋላ ሲሆን፣ በጂዛን ከተማ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትሏል። በአካባቢው ያለው የውጥረት ሁኔታ አሁንም የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካም በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን የንግድ እገዳ እና ወታደራዊ ዝግጅቷን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች።
oromo: gareen Hutiin jedhamu kan Iran deeggaramu, haleellaa xiyyaaraa kanaan dura Sa'udii Arabaa irratti raawwatamee ture hordofee haleellaa mishaayilii irratti raawwachuu isaa ibseera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame Sa'udiin buufataalee Hutiin Yemen keessatti qabu erga rukuttee booda yoo ta'u, magaala Jizaaniin keessatti ibidda kaaseera. Walitti buutiin naannichaa kan itti fufe yoo ta'u, Ameerikaanis dhiibbaa diinagdee fi qophii waraanaa gara Iranitti taasiftu itti fuftee jirti.

title: How Volker Turk won a new term as UN rights chief despite Israel opposition
english: Volker Turk has been re-elected as the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights for a second four-year term. Despite facing significant opposition from the United States, Russia, and Israel due to his vocal criticism of their policies, he received overwhelming support from the General Assembly. Turk, who has led the office since 2022, becomes the first individual to serve two consecutive terms in this role.
amharic: ቮልከር ቱርክ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነር ሆነው በድጋሚ ተመረጡ። በአሜሪካ፣ በሩሲያ እና በእስራኤል በኩል ጠንካራ ተቃውሞ ቢገጥማቸውም፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ባደረገው ድምፅ አብላጫ ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። ከ2022 ጀምሮ በኃላፊነት ላይ ያሉት ቱርክ፣ ይህንን ቦታ ለሁለት ተከታታይ ጊዜያት የመሩ የመጀመሪያው ሰው ሆነዋል።
oromo: Volker Turk yeroo lammaffaaf itti gaafatamaa mirga namoomaa kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii ta'anii filatamaniiru. Yaa'iin waliigalaa Mootummoota Gamtoomanii sagalee guddaadhaan deeggarsa isaa erga kenneefii booda, Turk waggoota afur ittaantuuf iddoo kana kan hogganan ta'a. Mootummoonni Ameerikaa, Raashiyaa fi Israa'el siyaasa isaanii irratti komii inni qabu mormus, Turk aangoo isaa itti fufuuf carraa argateera.

title: Israel arrests dozens of Palestinians in West Bank amid settler attacks
english: Israeli forces have launched a significant military operation in the occupied West Bank, arresting nearly 50 people following a deadly shooting that claimed the lives of both Israeli soldiers and Palestinians. Amid these raids, reports indicate that Israeli settlers have also targeted Palestinian homes and properties with arson. A UN official has condemned the ongoing violence, characterizing the incidents as attacks on defenseless civilians.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በተፈጸመ አሰቃቂ የተኩስ ልውውጥ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና የፍልስጤም ዜጎች ህይወት ካለፈ በኋላ፣ የእስራኤል ጦር በአካባቢው መጠነ ሰፊ ዘመቻ በመክፈት ወደ 50 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። በዚህ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን መሃል፣ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በፍልስጤማውያን መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር እሳት እየለቀቁ መሆኑ ተሰምቷል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባለስልጣን ይህንን የጥቃት ድርጊት በሲቪሎች ላይ የሚፈጸም የጭካኔ ተግባር ሲሉ አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el loltoota isaanii fi lammiilee Falasxeem irratti miidhaan erga gahee booda, daangaa Lixa Baank (West Bank) keessatti namoota 50 ol to'annaa jala oolchaniiru. Duula waraanaa kana gidduutti, qubattoonni Israa'el manneen jireenyaa Falasxeemotaa irratti lolaa fi mancaatii geessisuu gabaafameera. Bakka bu'aan tokko kan Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii ta'an, gochi kun siviilota harka qullaa irratti kan raawwatamee fi balaaleffatamuu qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: India’s education minister resigns after weeks of ‘Cockroach’ protests
english: India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned following widespread nationwide protests over significant examination paper leaks. The demonstrators, led by a group called the Cockroach Janta Party, celebrated the move as a major victory for the country's youth. Pradhan stated he stepped down to ensure students could return to their studies and to prevent political instability.
amharic: የህንድ የትምህርት ሚኒስትር ድሀርሜንድራ ፕራዳን በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ በተካሄዱ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች ምክንያት ከኃላፊነታቸው ለቀቁ። ተቃውሞው የተነሳው በተደጋጋሚ በተከሰቱ የፈተና ወረቀት መፍሰስ ችግሮች ሳቢያ ሲሆን፣ ራሳቸውን 'ኮክሮች ጃንታ ፓርቲ' ብለው የሚጠሩት ወጣቶች ለዚህ ድል መብቃታቸው ተነግሯል። ሚኒስትሩ ስልጣናቸውን የለቀቁት ተማሪዎች ወደ ትምህርታቸው እንዲመለሱ እና በሀገሪቱ ላይ ሊፈጠር የሚችል የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ለማስቀረት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministirri barnoota Indiyaa Dharmendra Pradhan, rakkoo lolaa qormaataa biyyoolessaa irratti hordofee uummata biratti mormiin guddaan erga kaee booda aangoo gadhiiseera. Gareen dargaggootaa 'Cockroach Janta Party' jedhamu hoogganu, tarkaanfiin kun injifannoo dargaggoota biyyattii ta'uu ibsee gammachuu isaa ibseera. Ministirichi aangoo gadhiisuu isaa kan ibse, barattoonni gara barnoota isaaniitti akka deebi'anifi rakkoo siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti uumamu hambisuuf ta'uu beeksiseera.

title: Israeli settlers rampage through Palestinian village near Nablus
english: Hundreds of Israeli settlers conducted a violent, organized attack on the Palestinian village of Sarra, located near Nablus in the occupied West Bank. During the assault, the attackers burned homes and vehicles while forcing many families to flee for their safety. Local residents reported that Israeli soldiers were present but failed to intervene as the property damage occurred.
amharic: በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ ናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሳራ ፍልስጤማውያን መንደር ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። በዚህ ጥቃት ወቅት ሰፋሪዎቹ ቤቶችን እና ተሽከርካሪዎችን በእሳት ያቃጠሉ ሲሆን በርካታ ቤተሰቦችም ደህንነታቸውን ለማስጠበቅ ከቤታቸው እንዲሸሹ ተገደዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደገለፁት ጥቃቱ ሲፈጸም የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአቅራቢያ ቢገኙም ምንም አይነት ጣልቃ ገብነት ሳያደርጉ መመልከታቸውን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Garee weerartoota Israa'el dhibbaan lakkaa'aman, baanki Lixaa magaalaa Naablusitti dhihoo jiru baadiyaa Saaraa jedhamtu irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaniiru. Weerara kanaan mana jireenyaa fi konkolaattoonni gubachuu irra darbee, maatiiwwan hedduun lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf iddoo sana gadhiisanii baqachuu dirqamaniiru. Jiraattoonni akka ibsanitti, waraanni Israa'el iddoo sana turanis, haleellaan kun yeroo raawwatamu tarkaanfii fudhachuu dhiisanii ilaalaa turan.

title: Number of detained Palestinians from overnight Israeli raids reaches 66
english: Israeli forces conducted a widespread series of raids across the occupied West Bank during the early hours of Saturday. These military operations resulted in the detention of at least 66 Palestinians across various cities and towns, including Nablus, Ramallah, and Hebron. This action marks a significant escalation in ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ቅዳሜ እለት በምዕራብ ባንክ በተለያዩ ከተሞች እና መንደሮች ባደረጉት መጠነ ሰፊ ኦፕሬሽን ቢያንስ 66 ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። እስሩ ናብሉስን፣ ራማላህን፣ ሄብሮንን እና ሌሎች አካባቢዎችን ያካተተ ነበር። ይህ ድርጊት በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humnootiin Israa'el ganama Sanbataa naannoo Qilleensa qabame (West Bank) keessatti tarkaanfii fudhataniin palasxinoonni 66 ta'an qabamaniiru. Qabamuu namoota kanaa magaalonni akka Naablus, Raamalaa fi Hebroon kan dabalatu yoo ta'u, kunis waldhabdee naannichaa kan hammaate ta'uu argisiisa.

title: UKMTO reports tanker 'encounter' with 'military forces' in Gulf of Oman
english: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations has reported a suspicious interaction between a commercial tanker and military personnel in the Gulf of Oman. Authorities are currently investigating the incident, though details regarding the identities of those involved remain unknown. Ships in the area have been cautioned to stay vigilant and monitor security updates closely.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የባህር ንግድ ኦፕሬሽንስ በኦማን ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ በአንድ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ እና በታጠቁ ኃይሎች መካከል የተፈጠረ ያልተለመደ ክስተት ማስታወቁን ዘግቧል። ባለስልጣናት ስለ ሁኔታው ምርመራ እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ስለ ተሳታፊዎቹ ማንነት እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም። በአካባቢው ያሉ ሌሎች መርከቦች ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ እና የደህንነት መረጃዎችን እንዲከታተሉ ተመክረዋል።
oromo: Hojiiwwan Daldala Galaanaa UK kan ta'an, galaana Oman keessatti markaba boba'aa fe'u fi humnoota waraanaa gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi uumamuusaa beeksisaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa haala kana qorachaa jiru, garuu eenyummaan namoota kanaan wal qabatan hanga ammaatti hin beekamu. Markaboonni naannichatti argaman of eeggannoo guddaa akka taasisanifi odeeffannoo nageenyaa hordofaa akka jiran dhaamaniiru.

title: Saudi Arabia downs missiles fired from Yemen
english: Saudi Arabian air defenses successfully intercepted two ballistic missiles fired from Yemen that were targeting oil refineries in the city of Yanbu. This incident follows threats of retaliation from the Houthi group in response to recent military actions by the Saudi-led coalition. Authorities had previously alerted citizens in the affected regions to remain cautious as tensions rise.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የአየር መከላከያ ሰራዊት ከየመን የተተኮሱ ሁለት የባለስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን በያንቡ ከተማ የሚገኙ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎችን ከመምታታቸው በፊት መትቶ መጣል ችሏል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ የተወሰደባቸውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ለመበቀል ዛቻ ካሰሙ በኋላ ነው። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ በጂዛን እና በያንቡ ከተሞች የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎችን ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉ አስጠንቅቀው ነበር።
oromo: Iccitiiwwan qilleensa irraa Sa’udii Arabiyaa, mishnaʼoota Yemen irraa dhukaafamanii fi raafinaoliin bobaʼaa magaalaa Yanbuu irratti xiyyeeffatan lama karaa irratti dhorkaniiru. Miidhaan kun kan uumame gareen Huutii, waraana Sa’udiin torban kana keessa isaan irratti raawwatameef haaloo baʼuuf waadaa seenuun isaa hordofee dha. Bulchiinsi Sa’udii miidhaa kana dura magaalonni Jiizaan fi Yanbuu keessa jiraattoonni akka of eeggannoo godhan akeekkachiisa dabarsanii turan.

title: Israeli forces conduct widespread raids across Jenin
english: Israeli military forces launched extensive raids across Jenin and several nearby villages on Saturday, targeting numerous neighborhoods and homes. These operations included areas providing shelter to displaced individuals from the Jenin refugee camp. Additionally, separate military actions near Nablus resulted in dozens of arrests and multiple injuries among Palestinians.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ቅዳሜ ዕለት በጀኒን ከተማ እና በአካባቢዋ ባሉ በርካታ መንደሮች ላይ ሰፊ ወረራ አካሂደዋል። በወረራውም የጀኒን የስደተኞች ካምፕ ነዋሪዎች መጠለያ አድርገው የሚጠቀሙባቸው ቤቶች ተካተዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ በናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በተካሄደ ሌላ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን መታሰራቸውና መቁሰላቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa’el Sanbata ganama magaalaa Jenin fi baadiyyaa ishee marsanii jiran irratti duula bal’aa gaggeessaniiru. Duulli kun bakka buqqaattonni kampii Jenin keessaa qubatanii jiranis kan dabalatu yoo ta’u, manneen hedduus sakatta’aniiru. Kana malees, magaalaa Naablus cinaatti waraanni kun namoota hedduu hidhuu fi kanneen biroo irratti miidhaa qaamaa geessisuun gabaafameera.

title: Dodging snipers, housing crisis forces Yemenis to live on front line
english: Families in Taiz, Yemen, are being forced to live in dangerous front-line areas because they cannot afford the high cost of housing elsewhere. Many, like one widowed mother, choose these unstable locations simply to survive on their limited incomes despite the constant risk of sniper attacks. This desperate situation highlights the severe humanitarian and economic crisis facing residents in a city where urban conflict remains a deadly threat.
amharic: በየመን ታኢዝ ከተማ የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች የመኖሪያ ቤት ኪራይ በመወደዱ ምክንያት በአደገኛ የጦር ግንባር አካባቢዎች ለመኖር ተገደዋል። እንደ አንዲት መበለት እናት ያሉ ነዋሪዎች፣ የጦር መሳሪያ ተኳሾች የሚያደርሱት ስጋት ቢኖርም፣ ከፍ ያለ የኪራይ ዋጋን መክፈል ባለመቻላቸው ብቻ በነዚህ አደገኛ ቦታዎች ለመኖር ይገደዳሉ። ይህ ሁኔታ በየመን እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት በሲቪል ነዋሪዎች ላይ የፈጠረውን ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ እና የደህንነት ቀውስ ያሳያል።
oromo: Maatiin magaalaa Ta'iz keessa jiraatan, gatiin mana jireenyaa waan itti hammaateef dirree waraanaa keessatti iddoo balaaf saaxilamoo ta'anitti jiraachuuf dirqamaniiru. Haati tokko kan taate fi maatiishee of bulchitu tun, balaa humnoota waraanaa irraa ishee mudatu osoo beektuu, gatii mana jireenyaa kaffaluu waan hin dandeenyeef iddoo kana filachuuf dirqamte. Rakkoon kun miidhaa diinagdee fi nageenyaa waraanni Yemen jiraattota irratti geessisaa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Wildfires in Spain and France force evacuation of 200,000 people
english: Massive, uncontrollable wildfires in Spain and France have forced nearly 200,000 residents and tourists to flee their homes and vacation spots. French authorities are evacuating regions near Bordeaux while Spain faces emergency conditions as fires near Madrid remain out of control due to difficult weather. Both nations have requested international assistance and military support to help manage the unprecedented scale of the destruction.
amharic: በስፔን እና በፈረንሳይ የተቀሰቀሱ ከፍተኛ እና መቆጣጠር ያልተቻሉ የደን ቃጠሎዎች ወደ ሁለት መቶ ሺህ የሚጠጉ ነዋሪዎችን እና ጎብኝዎችን ከቤታቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ አስገድደዋል። የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት በቦርዶ ከተማ አካባቢ ያሉ ሰዎችን እያወጡ ሲሆን ስፔንም በማድሪድ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተው አደጋ አስቸኳይ ጊዜ አውጃለች። ሁለቱም ሀገራት ይህንን ታይቶ የማይታወቅ አደጋ ለመቆጣጠር ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እና የወታደራዊ እርዳታ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa cimaa fi to’annoo ala ta’e garaa biyya Ispeenii fi Faransaayitti ka’een, namoonni 200,000 ol ta’an manaa fi bakka boqonnaa isaanii gadhiisanii baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Mootummaan Faransaay naannoo Bordootti namoota baqachiisaa jiru, Ispeen immoo naannoo Maadriditti ibidda to’annoo ala ta’e hordofee labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labsiteetti. Biyyoonni lamaanuu miidhaa cimaa mudate kana to’achuuf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa fi deeggarsa raayyaa ittisa biyyaa gaafataniiru.

title: Born too soon: Premature babies fight for survival in Gaza
english: The ongoing conflict in Gaza has led to a alarming rise in premature births and health complications for newborns. Expectant mothers are struggling with severe malnutrition, constant stress, and limited medical care, significantly increasing risks during pregnancy. Many families, like those at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, are forced to watch their infants battle for survival in neonatal units under extremely difficult conditions.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ጦርነት ያለጊዜው የሚወለዱ ሕፃናት ቁጥር እንዲጨምር እና ለሕፃናት ጤና መታወክ ምክንያት ሆኗል። እርጉዝ እናቶች በቂ ምግብ ባለማግኘት፣ በከፍተኛ ሥነ-ልቦናዊ ጫና እና በሕክምና አገልግሎት እጥረት ምክንያት ለከፍተኛ የጤና ችግሮች ተጋልጠዋል። በብዙ ሆስፒታሎች የሚገኙ እናቶችም ሕፃኖቻቸው በፅኑ እንክብካቤ ክፍል ውስጥ ለሕይወታቸው ሲታገሉ በከፍተኛ ጭንቀት እየተመለከቱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Waraanni Gaza keessatti adeemaa jiru lakkoofsa daa'imman yeroo hin geenyeetti dhalatanii fi rakkoolee fayyaa isaanii dabalee jira. Haadholiin ulfa ta'an rakkoo midhaan gahaa dhabuu, dhiphina sammuu fi hanqina tajaajila yaalaa mudataa jiranuun fayyaan isaanii balaadhaaf saaxilamee jira. Maatiin hedduun, kanneen akka hospitaala Al-Aqsa keessatti argaman, daa'imman isaanii iddoo qorannoo fayyaa keessatti lubbuun jiraachuuf yeroo qabsaa'an gadda guddaadhaan ilaalaa jiru.

title: Guterres arrives in Syria in first official visit by a UN chief in 17 years
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has arrived in Syria, marking the first visit by a UN leader to the nation in 17 years. During his multi-day trip, he plans to meet with President Ahmed al-Sharaa and other officials to discuss the country's recovery and future stability. Guterres will also inspect UN peacekeeping forces in the Golan Heights to monitor ceasefire agreements.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ዋና ጸሃፊ አንቶኒዮ ጉቴሬዝ ላለፉት 17 ዓመታት የመጀመሪያው የሆነውን ይፋዊ ጉብኝት ለማድረግ ሶሪያ ገብተዋል። በቆይታቸውም ከፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ጋር በመገናኘት ስለ ሀገሪቱ ቀጣይ መረጋጋት እና የልማት ስራዎች እንደሚወያዩ ይጠበቃል። በተጨማሪም በጎላን ኮረብታ የሚገኘውን የተመድ የሰላም አስከባሪ ሃይል በመጎብኘት የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን አፈጻጸም ይገመግማሉ።
oromo: Garee gamtaa mootummootaa kan ta'an Antonio Guterres waggaa 17 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf gara Siiriyaatti imaluun daawwannaa isaanii jalqabaniiru. Daawwannaa isaanii kanaanis pirezidaant Ahmed al-Sharaa waliin mari'achuun tasgabbii fi misooma biyyattii irratti ni mari'atu jedhamee eegama. Kana malees, waraana nageenya eegu kan UN irratti ramadamee jiru daawwachuun haala walii galtee dhaabbii waraanaa ni ilaalu.

title: Trump: ‘I’m running for a fourth term as President of the United States’
english: During the White House Correspondents' Association dinner, President Donald Trump made a joking remark about seeking a fourth term in office. This comment was lighthearted, as the United States Constitution strictly limits presidents to two terms. The event itself served as a gathering to recognize the importance of journalism and press freedom.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኋይት ሀውስ የጋዜጠኞች ማህበር እራት ግብዣ ላይ በአራተኛ ጊዜ ፕሬዚዳንትነት ስለመወዳደር በቀልድ መልክ ተናግረዋል። የአሜሪካ ህገ-መንግስት ፕሬዚዳንቶች ከሁለት ጊዜ በላይ እንዳይመረጡ ቢከለክልም ትራምፕ ግን ይህንን መግለጫ የሰጡት በቀልድ መልክ ነው። ዝግጅቱ ለፕሬስ ነፃነት ክብር የሚሰጥ እና የጋዜጠኝነት ስራን የሚያከብር ስነ-ስርዓት ነበር።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Ameerikaa Donald Traamp, cidha dhaabbata gaazexeessitoota Waayit Hawusirratti afurreeffatee filatamuu danda'a jechuun qoosaa godhaniiru. Heerri Ameerikaa pirezedaantii tokkoof heeyyamu kan lameen qofa ta'us, yaanni isaanii kun kan dubbatame qoosaadhaan ture. Sagantaan kun bilisummaa miidiyaa fi hojii gaazexeessummaa kan kabajuufi kan kabajamuu ture.

title: Venezuelans hold vigil one month after devastating earthquakes
english: One month has passed since major earthquakes hit Venezuela, leaving over 5,500 people dead and many others still missing. Families continue to search through the ruins of collapsed structures as they mourn those lost. Survivors are calling for more international aid and faster recovery efforts to address the ongoing crisis.
amharic: ቬኔዙዌላ ውስጥ አስከፊው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ከተከሰተ አንድ ወር አልፏል። በዚህ አደጋ ከ5,500 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎች አሁንም የደረሱበት አልታወቀም። የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ፈራርሰው በወደቁ ህንፃዎች ውስጥ የጠፉ ዘመዶቻቸውን ፍለጋቸውን የቀጠሉ ሲሆን፣ አፋጣኝ አለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልግም እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Venezuela keessatti raafama lafaa cimaa sana booda ji'a tokko lakkoofsiseera. Balaa kanaan namoonni 5,500 ol du'anii, ammas namoonni hedduun bakka buuteen isaanii hin beekamu. Maatiin miidhame qe'ee diigame keessatti firoota isaanii barbaaduu itti fufanii jiru; akkasumas gargaarsi idil-addunyaa hatattamaan akka barbaachisu gaafachaa jiru.

title: South Africa’s le Clos breaks Commonwealth Games record with 19th medal
english: South African swimmer Chad le Clos has become the most decorated male athlete in Commonwealth Games history by winning his 19th career medal. He achieved this milestone after earning bronze in the men's 4x100-meter freestyle relay. The 34-year-old athlete, who has competed in five Games, holds a prestigious collection of gold, silver, and bronze medals and aims to continue his career through the 2028 Olympics.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካው ዋናተኛ ቻድ ለ ክሎስ በኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች ታሪክ 19ኛ ሜዳሊያውን በማግኘት በውድድሩ ታሪክ ከፍተኛ ስኬት ያስመዘገበ ወንድ አትሌት ሆኗል። ይህንን ታሪካዊ ውጤት ያስመዘገበው በወንዶች 4x100 ሜትር ፍሪስታይል ቅብብሎሽ የነሐስ ሜዳሊያ በማሸነፍ ነው። በአምስት የኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች ላይ የተሳተፈው የ34 ዓመቱ አትሌት፣ በስፖርት ህይወቱ የተለያዩ ሜዳሊያዎችን የሰበሰበ ሲሆን በ2028 ኦሊምፒክም ለመሳተፍ አቅዷል።
oromo: Leenji’aan daakkuu biyya Afrikaa Kibbaa Chad le Clos, meedaaliyaa 19ffaa isaa mo’achuudhaan seenaa taphoota Commonwealth keessatti atleetii dhiiraa meedaaliyaa baay’ee argate ta’eera. Milkaa’ina kana kan argate dorgommii daakkuu 4x100 meetiraa keessatti meedaaliyaa naasii (bronze) argachuudhaani. Atleetichi umrii 34 fi taphoota shanii irratti kan hirmaate yoo ta’u, meedaaliyaa hedduu walitti qabachuun, gara fuulduraatti bara 2028 taphoota Olompikii irrattis hirmaachuuf karoorfateera.

title: Funerals held for four Palestinians killed in deadly West Bank shooting
english: Four Palestinians were laid to rest following a deadly incident near Nablus in the occupied West Bank. Palestinian authorities have accused Israeli settlers and security forces of orchestrating the violence. Conversely, Israeli officials claim the confrontation was triggered by an initial attack against their own civilians.
amharic: በተያዘው የምዕራብ ባንክ ናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በተፈጠረ ገዳይ ጥቃት ህይወታቸው ያለፈ አራት ፍልስጤማውያን የቀብር ስነ ስርዓት ተፈጽሟል። የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች እና በወታደሮች እንደተፈጸመ ይገልጻሉ። የእስራኤል በኩል ደግሞ ግጭቱ የተቀሰቀሰው በሲቪል ዜጎቻቸው ላይ በደረሰ ጥቃት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Nablus, naannoo Qilleensaa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti namoonni Palastiniin afur ajjeefamanii sirni awwaalcha isaanii raawwatameera. Aangeyyoonni Palastinii haleellaa kana kan raawwatan qondaaltotaa fi godaantota Israa'el ta'uu himatu. Gama biraatiin, Israa'el gamachuu kana kan kaase haleellaa siivilota isaanii irratti jalqaba raawwatame dha jechuun falmiti.

title: ‘The show must go on’: Trump returns to rescheduled White House press gala
english: President Donald Trump recently headlined a rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner, which had been abruptly canceled in April due to a failed assassination attempt. During the event, Trump delivered jokes and mocked his political rivals, while also praising his staff for their actions during the previous security crisis. The gathering was held with a significantly reduced guest list compared to the original ceremony.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሚያዝያ ወር የግድያ ሙከራ ምክንያት ተቋርጦ የነበረውን የኋይት ሀውስ ጋዜጠኞች እራት በድጋሚ ተገኝተው አከበሩ። በክብረ በዓሉ ላይ ትራምፕ ቀልዶችን በመቀለድ ተቃዋሚዎቻቸውን የሰነዘሩ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ሲል በነበረው የጥቃት ሙከራ ወቅት ለታዩት ረዳቶቻቸው ምስጋና አቅርበዋል። ይህ ዝግጅት ከቀድሞው ጋር ሲነፃፀር በተቀነሰ የእንግዶች ቁጥር ነው የተካሄደው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Dooktar Doonald tiraamp, ji'a Eeblaa keessa yaalii ajjeechaa isaan irratti gaggeeffameen addaan citee ture sagantaa fiixii giddu galeessa gaazexeessitoota Waayit Hawus irra deebi'anii hirmaataniiru. Sagantaa kana irratti tiraamp jeequmsa siyaasaa fi qoosuu irra darbee, yeroo haleellaa kanaan duraa gargaartonni isaanii gootummaa agarsiisaniif galata galchaniiru. Ayyaanni kun namoota muraasa qofa affeeruun kan gaggeeffame yoo ta'u, bakka Waldorf Astoria keessatti geggeeffameera.

title: Firefighters battle fire after fertiliser explosion in England
english: A major fire broke out at a farm in Essex, England, following an explosion involving fertilizer. Emergency crews arrived in large numbers to extinguish the blaze and prevent the flames from spreading to residential areas. Authorities successfully managed the situation to ensure public safety.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ኤሴክስ በሚገኝ አንድ የእርሻ ቦታ ላይ በማዳበሪያ ፍንዳታ ምክንያት ትልቅ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር እና በአቅራቢያው ወደሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እንዳይዛመት ለመከላከል ከፍተኛ ጥረት አድርገዋል። ባለስልጣናት የህዝብን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ሁኔታውን በተሳካ ሁኔታ ተቆጣጥረውታል።
oromo: Ingilaaz, naannoo Eseksitti qonna tokko keessatti xaa'oo oomisha qonnaa (fertilizer) dhohuun ibidda cimaan ka'ee jira. Hojjettoonni dhaamsaa ibiddaa ibidda kana dhaamsanii fi manneen jireenyaa ollaa jiran irraa akka itti hin babal'anne ittisuuf halkan guyyaa hojjetaa turan. Qaamoleen nageenyaa balaan kun ummata irra miidhaa akka hin geessisneef to'annoo jala oolchanii jiru.

title: From palava huts to TikTok: How Liberians are preserving their past
english: Young Liberians are embracing digital platforms like TikTok and podcasts to preserve their country's history and cultural heritage. Previously, this knowledge was passed down orally by elders, but civil conflicts disrupted these traditions. Now, projects like Archive Liberia are using modern technology to reclaim these stories and ensure they remain accessible to future generations.
amharic: ወጣት ላይቤሪያውያን የሀገራቸውን ታሪክ እና ባህል ለመጠበቅ እንደ ቲኪቶክ እና ፖድካስት ያሉ ዲጂታል መድረኮችን እየተጠቀሙ ነው። ከዚህ በፊት ታሪክ በአፍ መፍቻ በኩል ከትውልድ ወደ ትውልድ ይተላለፍ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነቶች ይህን ሂደት አቋርጠውት ነበር። በአሁኑ ጊዜ፣ እንደ 'አርካይቭ ላይቤሪያ' ያሉ ፕሮጀክቶች እነዚህን ታሪኮች ለመታደግ እና ለቀጣዩ ትውልድ ለማድረስ ዘመናዊ ቴክኖሎጂን እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Dargaggoonni Libeeriyaa seenaa fi aadaa biyyattii isaanii eeggachuuf fayyadamummaa marsariitiiwwan dijitaalaa akka TikTok fi podkaastii babal'isaniiru. Kanaan dura beekumsi kun maanguddootaan afoolaan dhaloota darba ture, garuu waraanni biyyattii keessaa aadaa kana miidhee ture. Amma, dhaabbileen akka 'Arkaayiv Libeeriyaa' seenaa kana deebisanii guddisuufi dhaloota dhufuuf tursuuf teeknoolojii ammayyaa fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Sons of immigrant killed by ICE in Texas share grief, demand accountability
english: The sons of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, a Mexican immigrant fatally shot by ICE agents during a traffic stop in Texas, are calling for a transparent investigation into their father's death. The 52-year-old was not the target of the operation, and conflicting reports regarding the incident have surfaced since agents lacked body cameras. Local authorities have also reported that federal officials are withholding critical evidence, prompting families and lawmakers to demand greater accountability.
amharic: በቴክሳስ በኢሚግሬሽን እና ጉምሩክ ባለስልጣናት (ICE) በተተኮሰ ጥይት የተገደለው የሎሬንዞ ሳልጋዶ አራውጆ ልጆች የአባታቸው ሞት ፍትሃዊ እና ግልፅ ምርመራ እንዲደረግለት ጠይቀዋል። አባታቸው በኦፕሬሽኑ ኢላማ ያልነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የድርጊቱ የሰውነት ካሜራ ማስረጃ አለመኖሩ እና የፌዴራል አካላት መረጃዎችን መደበቃቸው ሁኔታውን አወዛጋቢ አድርጎታል። ጉዳዩ የቤተሰቡን እና የህግ አውጪዎችን ተቃውሞ በመቀስቀስ፣ ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር ግፊት እየተደረገበት ነው።
oromo: Ilmaan namicha godaanticha Lorenzo Salgado Araujo jedhamu, kan humnoota ICE irratti dhukaasanii ajjeesan, du’a abbaa isaanii irratti qorannoon ifaa ta’e akka gaggeeffamu gaafachaa jiru. Abbaan isaanii umurii waggaa 52, hojii to’annoo sanarratti kan hin barbaadamne yoo ta’u, ragaan kaameraa qaamaa waan hin jirreef fi qaamni federalaa ragaa dhoksaa waan jiruuf dhugaan achi keessa jiru shakkiin irra jira. Maatiin fi miseensonni seera baastootaa dhimmi kun qulqullaa’ee namoonni itti gaafataman seeraatti akka dhiyaatan jabaatanii gaafachaa jiru.

title: Trump threatens EU will pay ‘big price’ after Brussels fines Google $1bn
english: President Donald Trump has warned the European Union of potential trade penalties after Brussels imposed a $1 billion fine on Google for antitrust violations. The EU accused the tech giant of unfairly prioritizing its own services and restricting app developers. Trump labeled these actions discriminatory and vowed to protect US companies from what he views as unfair European interference.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአውሮፓ ህብረት ጉግልን በአንድ ቢሊዮን ዶላር ከቀጣ በኋላ ህብረቱ ከፍተኛ ዋጋ እንደሚከፍል አስጠንቅቀዋል። የአውሮፓ ህብረት ጉግል የራሱን አገልግሎቶች በማስቀደም እና የአፕሊኬሽን አዘጋጆችን በመገደብ ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት ፈጽሟል ሲል ከሷል። ትራምፕ ይህንን የህብረቱ ውሳኔ አድሏዊ ነው በማለት አሜሪካዊ ኩባንያዎችን ለመከላከል አጸፋዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaanald Traamp biyyoonni Gamtaa Awurooppaa Google irratti adabbii pilaayiliyoona tokkoo erga murteessanii booda, tarkaanfii daldalaa cimaa akka fudhatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Gamtaan Awurooppaa, Google tajaajila mataa isaa fayyadamuuf jecha dorgomtoota isaa miidheera jedhee kan himate yoo ta'u, Traamp ammoo tarkaanfii kana kan morman ta'uu ibsaniiru. Pirezidaantichi qabeenya fi fayyidaa dhaabbilee Ameerikaa eeguuf jecha Gamtaa Awurooppaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Texts reveal 14-year-old allegedly murdered by singer D4vd had pregnancy and abortion
english: Singer D4vd, legally named David Anthony Burke, is facing trial for the alleged murder and sexual abuse of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. Court documents reveal text messages between the two detailing a pregnancy and an abortion that occurred while the girl was still a minor. Prosecutors claim Burke killed the victim to silence her after she threatened to expose his history of abuse, which could have ruined his music career.
amharic: ዴቪድ አንቶኒ በርክ በሚል መጠሪያ የሚታወቀው ዘፋኝ ዲፎቪዲ (D4vd) የ14 ዓመቷን ሴለስቲ ሪቫስ ሄርናንዴዝን በመግደል እና ወሲባዊ ጥቃት በመፈጸም ተከሶ ፍርድ ቤት ቀርቧል። በሁለቱ መካከል የተለዋወጡ የጽሑፍ መልእክቶች ልጅቷ ታዳጊ እያለች እርግዝና እና ፅንስ ማስወረድ እንደነበረባት ያሳያሉ። አቃቤ ሕጎች እንደገለጹት ዘፋኙ ግድያውን የፈጸመው ልጅቷ በደረሰባት በደል ላይ እውነቱን እናወጣለሁ ብላ በማስፈራራቷ የተነሳ የሙያ ህይወቱ እንዳይበላሽ ለመከላከል ነው።
oromo: Weellisaan D4vd jedhamu, maqaan isaa seeraa David Anthony Burke, mucayyoo waggaa 14, Celeste Rivas Hernandez ajjeese fi miidhaa saalqunnamtii irra ga'e jedhamee himatamee jira. Odeeffannoon mana murtiitti dhiyaate akka agarsiisutti, lamaan isaanii gidduutti ergaawwan wal jijjiiraman keessatti mucayyoon kun yeroo waggaa 13 turte ulfooftee akka turte fi baasuu ishee ifa ta'eera. Abbaan alangaa akka jedhutti, shakkatamaan kun ajjeechaa kana raawwate, mucayyoon kun miidhaa irra ga'e akka saaxiltu waan doorsisteef, hojiin muuziqaa isaa akka hin balleessineef jedhee akka ta'e dubbateera.

title: GLP-1s are changing US healthcare, should everyone be on them?
english: GLP-1 medications, which were initially designed to manage diabetes, are now significantly impacting the American healthcare system due to their effectiveness in weight loss. As researchers discover additional health advantages, medical experts are debating the potential for broader use of these drugs among the general population. This ongoing shift raises important questions about who should ultimately be prescribed these treatments.
amharic: መጀመሪያ ለስኳር ህመም ህክምና የተዘጋጁት የGLP-1 መድሃኒቶች ለክብደት መቀነስ ያላቸው ፋይዳ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የጤና እንክብካቤ ዘርፍ ላይ ከፍተኛ ለውጥ እያመጡ ነው። ተመራማሪዎች በእነዚህ መድሃኒቶች ላይ ተጨማሪ የጤና ጠቀሜታዎችን እየለዩ በመሆኑ፣ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች መድሃኒቶቹን ለሰፊው ህዝብ የመጠቀም እድልን እየተወያዩበት ይገኛል። ይህ ለውጥ መድሃኒቶቹ ለማን መሰጠት አለባቸው በሚለው ላይ ትልቅ ጥያቄን እያስነሳ ነው።
oromo: Qorichoonni GLP-1 jedhaman kan jalqaba dhukkuba sukkaaraaf qophaa'an, yeroo ammaa furdina qaamaa hir'isuuf bu'aa qabaachuu isaaniitiin sirna fayyaa Ameerikaa keessatti jijjiirama guddaa fidaa jiru. Qorattoonni fayyadamni qorichoota kanaa faayidaa fayyaa dabalataa akka qaban waan argataniif, ogeeyyiin fayyaa namoota hedduuf kennamuu danda'a jedhanii falmaa jiru. Jijjiiramni kun gara fuulduraatti namoonni kam akka qoricha kana fayyadamuu qaban irratti gaaffii cimaa kaasuu danda'a.

title: Saudi-led coalition strikes Houthi-controlled Hodeidah
english: The Saudi-led coalition conducted airstrikes against Houthi-held military and communication locations in the Hodeidah region. This military action follows threats from the Houthi movement to strike Saudi oil sites and maritime trade routes. These developments have heightened concerns regarding a potential escalation of conflict within the region.
amharic: በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሁቲዎች ቁጥጥር ስር በሚገኙት የሁዳይዳ ግዛት ወታደራዊ እና የቴሌኮም ተቋማት ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያዎች እና የባህር ላይ ትራንስፖርት ላይ ጥቃት እንደሚሰነዝሩ ካስጠነቀቁ በኋላ ነው። ይህ ግጭት በአካባቢው ያለውን የፀጥታ ሁኔታ ይበልጥ አሳሳቢ እንደሚያደርገው ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Mootummoota Saudii durfamuun gareen waraanaa, lafa Houthii to’atanii jiran kan Hodeidah keessatti bakkeewwan waraanaa fi bu’uuraalee quunnamtii irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwate. Haleellaan kun kan dhufte erga Houthiin buufataalee boba’aa Saudii fi karaalee doonii irratti haleellaa akka gaggeessan doorsisanii booda. Gochi kun naannichatti waraanni akka itti fufuufi hammaatu sodaachiseera.

title: UN rights chief Turk wins second term despite US and Israeli opposition
english: Volker Turk has been re-elected for a second four-year term as the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, becoming the first official to serve two consecutive terms in this position. Despite strong opposition from the United States, Israel, and several other nations, he secured the role with a wide majority of 144 votes. Turk is known for his vocal criticism of Israel's military actions in Gaza and his consistent calls for international humanitarian law compliance.
amharic: ቮልከር ቱርክ ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰብአዊ መብቶች ከፍተኛ ኮሚሽነር ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በሌሎች ጥቂት ሀገራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ቢገጥማቸውም፣ 144 ድምጽ በማግኘት ለተጨማሪ አራት ዓመታት ስልጣናቸውን እንዲቀጥሉ ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። በጋዛ ስለሚፈጸሙ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እና አለም አቀፍ ህጎች አፈጻጸም ላይ ባላቸው ጠንካራ አቋም የሚታወቁት ቱርክ፣ ይህንን ቦታ ለሁለት ተከታታይ ጊዜያት የሚይዙ የመጀመሪያው ሰው ይሆናሉ።
oromo: Volker Turk geggeessituu mirga namummaa kan dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti ta'uun waggoota afuriif lammaffaa akka tajaajilan filatamaniiru. Biyyoota akka Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irraa mormiin cimaan isaan mudatus, sagalee 144 argachuun xumura kanaan aangoo isaanii itti fufuuf ta'eera. Turk gocha waraanaa Israa'el kan Gaaza keessatti raawwatamu cimsanii kan morman yoo ta'u, kanaanis aangoo kana waggaa saddeetiif kan turan duraa ta'uun seenaa hojjetaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump says US ‘locked and loaded’ as it seeks Iran talks
english: President Trump has stated that the United States is prepared for military action but is still open to diplomatic negotiations with Iran. This follows reports that Iran attacked American bases in the Middle East. Meanwhile, Iran's Foreign Minister has declared that his country will not yield to external threats or pressure.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ለወታደራዊ እርምጃ ዝግጁ መሆኗን ቢገልጹም፣ አሁንም ከኢራን ጋር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመነጋገር ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው አስታውቀዋል። ይህ የሆነው ኢራን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ የጦር ሰፈሮች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን ተከትሎ ነው። በበኩሉ የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አገራቸው በምንም አይነት ማስፈራሪያ እና ጫና እንደማትበገር ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp yeroo ammaa qophii waraanaaf akka jiran ibsanus, karaa mariin Iran waliin araara buusuuf fedhii qaban ibsaniiru. Kun kan ta'e erga Iran buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa kanneen biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaatti argaman irratti haleellaa raawwatte booda. Gama biraatiin, ministirri dhimmi alaa Iran biyyi isaanii dhiibbaa fi doorsisa tokko illee akka hin fudhanne ibsaniiru.

title: Trump says ‘it’s time’ for Saudi Arabia to normalise ties with Israel
english: President Donald Trump has declared that Saudi Arabia must normalize diplomatic relations with Israel to proceed with a civilian nuclear cooperation agreement. Although a nuclear deal was recently signed, Trump is now insisting that Riyadh join the Abraham Accords as a prerequisite for the partnership. Saudi Arabia has previously maintained that it will not recognize Israel until a viable plan for Palestinian statehood is established.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከእስራኤል ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቷን ካላስተካከለች የኒውክሌር ቴክኖሎጂ ስምምነቷ ተግባራዊ እንደማይሆን አስታውቀዋል። ምንም እንኳን የኒውክሌር ስምምነቱ ቀደም ብሎ ቢፈረምም፣ አሁን ግን ትራምፕ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በአብርሃም ስምምነት ውስጥ እንድትገባ ቅድመ ሁኔታ አስቀምጠዋል። ሳውዲ አረቢያ በበኩሏ የፍልስጤም መንግሥት እስኪመሠረት ድረስ ከእስራኤል ጋር ግንኙነት እንደማትፈጥር ቀደም ሲል አቋሟን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp Sa’udii Arabiyaan walii galtee niwukileerii waliin mallatteessite hojii irra oolchuuf duraan Israa’el wajjin hariiroo dippilomaasii diriirsuu qabdi jedhaniiru. Walii galteen kun kanaan dura mallatteeffamee tureyyuu, Tiraamp amma Sa’udiin 'Abraham Accords' keessatti hirmaachuu akka qabdu haala itti guuraniiru. Sa’udi Arabiyaan ammoo hanga biyyi Filisxeem hundaa’utti Israa’elii wajjin hariiroo uumuu akka hin dandeenye irra deddeebitee ibsaa turte.

title: Centcom says tanker trying to evade Iran port blockade 'disabled'
english: The U.S. military successfully stopped a tanker that repeatedly ignored warnings while trying to bypass a blockade on Iranian ports. American forces fired into the vessel's engine room to disable it after the crew refused to comply with multiple orders. The ship has been successfully prevented from reaching its destination in Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ወደ ኢራን ወደቦች ለማምራት የሞከረ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብን አስቁመዋል። መርከቧ ተደጋጋሚ የማስጠንቀቂያ መልእክቶችን ባለመቀበሏ የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች የሞተር ክፍሏን በመምታት እንዲቆም አድርገውታል። በዚህም ምክንያት መርከቧ ጉዞዋን መቀጠል ሳትችል ቀርታለች።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa doonii boba'aa gara buufataalee Iraanitti imalaa turte erga akeekkachiisa irra deddeebi'anii kennaniin booda dhaabsisaniiru. Dooniin kun ajaja hin fudhatne yeroo jedhamu, humnoonni Ameerikaa kutaa injinarii ishee dhukaasun doonittii kutaanii jiru. Kanaafuu, dooniin tun gara Iraanitti imaluu hin dandeenye.

title: HRW: Ben-Gvir’s crocodile-filled moat plan ‘cartoonishly cruel’
english: Human Rights Watch has criticized an Israeli minister's proposal to create a crocodile-filled moat around a prison for Palestinian detainees, labeling the idea as unnecessarily cruel. The organization argues that instead of spending money on such extreme and performative measures, the government should prioritize investigating reports of abuse within its detention centers. Officials were urged to focus on accountability for human rights violations rather than pursuing such bizarre suggestions.
amharic: ሂዩማን ራይትስ ዋች እስራኤል ፍልስጤማውያን ታሳሪዎች የሚገኙበትን ማረሚያ ቤት በአዞ በተሞላ ጉድጓድ ለመከበብ ያቀረበችውን እቅድ ጭካኔ የተሞላበት ሲል አጣጥሏል። ድርጅቱ መንግስት እንዲህ አይነት ትርጉም የለሽ እና አላስፈላጊ ወጪ የሚጠይቁ እቅዶችን ከመተግበር ይልቅ፣ በእስር ቤቶች ውስጥ የሚፈጸሙ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን በመመርመር ተጠያቂዎችን ለህግ ማቅረብ እንዳለበት አሳስቧል። ዋናው ትኩረት በሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች ላይ ግልጽ ምርመራ ማድረግ ላይ መሆን እንዳለበት ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humni mirga namoomaa (Human Rights Watch) ministarri Israa'el tokko hidhattoota Falasxiin itti hidhaman bakka sana naannoo isaa qocaa bishaan keessa jiraatuun (crocodile) maruuf karoorfate, tarkaanfii baay'ee hamaa fi nama ajaa'ibu jechuun balaaleffateera. Dhaabbatichi akka jedhutti, mootummaan Israa'el qisaasa kanaan mannaa, mana hidhaa sana keessatti dararaa raawwatamu qorachuudhaan qaamota itti gaafatamtoota ta'an seeraatti dhiyeessuu qaba. Mootummaan karoorawwan akkasii irra, mirga namoomaa kabachiisuu fi yakka raawwatame irratti qulqullinaan qorachuu irratti xiyyeeffachuu akka qabu dhaamameera.

title: Houthis say Saudi attack on Hodeidah will lead to 'escalation for escalation'
english: The Houthi movement has accused Saudi Arabia of launching military strikes against telecommunications infrastructure in Hodeidah and Kamaran Island, which resulted in injuries. In response, the group warned that these actions will lead to further military retaliation rather than peace. They further condemned the Saudi-led blockade on Yemen and stated that the kingdom will face significant consequences for these recent hostilities.

oromo: Humni Huthotaa Saudi Arabiyaa magaalaa Hodeidah keessatti bu'uuraalee misooma telekoomii fi oddola Kamaran irratti haleellaa raawwachuu ishee balaaleffateera.
